tailgate-fixture.text: It's been part of this tailgate longer than you have. Still not the answer.
Fixtures don't move, and neither does the outcome here.

tailgate-gear.text: Useful equipment. Useless as an answer.
That gear has done its job today. Being correct was not its job.

people.text: A person is a valid guess. Rarely a correct one.
People are unpredictable. This guess was not, and it still lost.

Human suspects are always in play. They're rarely the answer.

matt-variant.text: Another version of Matt appeared. It didn't clarify anything.
Matt, in any form, remains hard to predict.
Whichever Matt you're looking at, he's not the point right now.
